title: Diamond Ideal Lock-In Detector Theorem Note
verdict_rationale: Direct cycle-average algebra supports the X and Y formulas and the nondegenerate phase/slope result. The runner’s asserted checks all pass, but it tests drive-off only as a channel-null control and never validates the phase claim at A_z = 0. Because that admitted case makes atan2(Y_z,X_z) undefined, the source’s unqualified theorem does not close on its own stated domain.
